title: AnimationPlayer with SpriteFrames3D errors when using 'frame' as animated value
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.1.dev (8188bc7118817a200ecd). This is earliest version I tested.
- Reproducible in 4.6.dev (dec5a373d97cbadce5e1)
- Issue appears to have existed long term and still exists in latest Master commit.

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (dec5a373d) - Linux Mint 22 (Wilma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 550.163.01) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11600K @ 3.90GHz (12 threads) - 94.19 GiB memory

### Issue description

If animating individual property 'frame' from an AnimatedSprite3D in a AnimationPlayer the following error is emitted in the editor per refresh when the animation editor is visible. 
- AnimatedSprite3D must have more than 1 sprite animation. 
- Animation editor must be visible and displayed.

```
scene/resources/animation.cpp:1455 - Index p_track = -1 is out of bounds (tracks.size() = 1).
  scene/resources/animation.cpp:1809 - Index p_track = -1 is out of bounds (tracks.size() = 1).
  Animation '<null>' doesn't exist.
```

If the user adds 'animation' from AnimatedSprite3D this error disappears.

The animation editor appears to be expecting to find 'animation' as an animated property in the animation.  When this does not exist it instead accesses an invalid animation track.  
We do not see this when AnimatedSprite3D contains exactly 1 sprite animation.
The following ref from the animation editor shows one of the locations where I expect this is caused by.  We see it trying to access the 'animation' track without any checks on if it was valid.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bd65cfa876df82f67842ce447ba6c3d28893e7ca/editor/animation/animation_track_editor_plugins.cpp#L504C3-L522C37
A second location can be found at L412.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene
2. Create an AnimationPlayer node.
3. Create a AnimatedSprite3D node
4. On AnimatedSprite3D node, create a new sprite animation.
5. On this sprite animation, create  >= 2x animations.  
6. On the AnimatedSprite3D node, set 'frame' property as an animation key.
7. Change editor tab to 'Animation'.
8. Should now see popup errors in editor and console.
9. On the AnimatedSprite3D node, set 'animation' property as a extra animation key.
10. Change editor tab to 'Animation'. 
11. Should no longer see popup errors in editor and console. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[20251206_animation_player_with_sprite_frames.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24016594/20251206_animation_player_with_sprite_frames.tar.gz)
